result:
### Summary of Changes

To ensure inline and shared metrics on the same experiment always maintain distinct internal identifiers and display their own results, the following changes were made:

1. **Always assign fresh UUID on saved metric creation** in [`ExperimentSavedMetricService.normalize_query_for_write`](file:///Users/yoavshmariahu/src/thinker/.worktrees/systematic-cache-setup/bench/worktrees/posthog-posthog-flash-systematic-0/products/experiments/backend/experiment_saved_metric_service.py#L131-L146):
   - Previously, creating a saved metric would preserve an incoming `uuid` in the query payload if present. When promoting an inline metric to a shared metric, this caused the newly created shared metric to keep the inline metric's identifier.
   - Updated the logic so when `existing_uuid` is not provided (creation path), a new `str(uuid4())` is always assigned to `normalized_query["uuid"]`, preventing promoted shared metrics from inheriting the inline metric's identifier. Updates to existing saved metrics continue to preserve their `existing_uuid`.

2. **Detect and regenerate colliding stored inline metrics on `saved_metrics_ids`-only updates** in [`ExperimentService.update_experiment`](file:///Users/yoavshmariahu/src/thinker/.worktrees/systematic-cache-setup/bench/worktrees/posthog-posthog-flash-systematic-0/products/experiments/backend/experiment_service.py#L3628-L3642):
   - When an update payload only provided `saved_metrics_ids` without sending `metrics` or `metrics_secondary`, existing stored inline metrics were never validated against the incoming shared metrics.
   - Added collision checks when `"saved_metrics_ids"` is in `update_data`: if any stored inline metric in `experiment.metrics` or `experiment.metrics_secondary` shares a UUID with the attached saved metrics, that metric list is staged into `update_data` so [`_assign_uuids_to_metrics`](file:///Users/yoavshmariahu/src/thinker/.worktrees/systematic-cache-setup/bench/worktrees/posthog-posthog-flash-systematic-0/products/experiments/backend/experiment_service.py#L1713-L1746) regenerates fresh, non-colliding UUIDs.

3. **Preserve saved metric identifiers in ordering synchronization** in [`ExperimentService._sync_ordering_with_metric_changes`](file:///Users/yoavshmariahu/src/thinker/.worktrees/systematic-cache-setup/bench/worktrees/posthog-posthog-flash-systematic-0/products/experiments/backend/experiment_service.py#L4933-L4975):
   - When an inline metric's UUID is regenerated away from a colliding UUID, that old UUID must not be pruned from `primary_metrics_ordered_uuids` or `secondary_metrics_ordered_uuids` if it belongs to an attached saved metric.
   - Subtracted the saved metric UUIDs from `removed` when syncing ordering arrays so both the shared metric and the newly-assigned inline metric UUID remain in the ordering list.

4. **Update agent guidance against creating duplicate metrics** in [metric-configuration.md.j2](file:///Users/yoavshmariahu/src/thinker/.worktrees/systematic-cache-setup/bench/worktrees/posthog-posthog-flash-systematic-0/products/experiments/skills/configuring-experiment-analytics/references/metric-configuration.md.j2#L296-L305):
   - Replaced guidance that recommended promoting an inline metric with the same query and attaching it alongside the existing inline copy with instructions to remove the original inline metric from `metrics` (or `metrics_secondary`) upon attaching the converted shared metric.

5. **Tests**:
   - Added [`test_create_saved_metric_generates_new_uuid_when_query_has_uuid`](file:///Users/yoavshmariahu/src/thinker/.worktrees/systematic-cache-setup/bench/worktrees/posthog-posthog-flash-systematic-0/products/experiments/backend/test/test_experiment_saved_metric_service.py#L39-L52) in [`TestExperimentSavedMetricService`](file:///Users/yoavshmariahu/src/thinker/.worktrees/systematic-cache-setup/bench/worktrees/posthog-posthog-flash-systematic-0/products/experiments/backend/test/test_experiment_saved_metric_service.py#L14) to verify that creating a saved metric generates a fresh UUID even when the query defines one.
   - Added [`test_saved_metrics_only_update_regenerates_colliding_inline_metric_uuid`](file:///Users/yoavshmariahu/src/thinker/.worktrees/systematic-cache-setup/bench/worktrees/posthog-posthog-flash-systematic-0/products/experiments/backend/test/test_experiment_service.py#L6156-L6218) in [`TestExperimentService`](file:///Users/yoavshmariahu/src/thinker/.worktrees/systematic-cache-setup/bench/worktrees/posthog-posthog-flash-systematic-0/products/experiments/backend/test/test_experiment_service.py#L22) to verify that attaching a shared metric via a `saved_metrics_ids`-only update regenerates colliding stored inline metric UUIDs while preserving both metrics in ordering.
